name: session-deck
description: A pane beside the chat with context fill, plan usage limits, implementation plan progress and scheduled tasks

handoffAt.title: Handoff mark
handoffAt.description: Context percent the deck marks for a handoff, with a toast when it is reached and a warning 10 points earlier

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: What the deck pins under the prompt: full (context and limits), limits (for a status line that already shows context) or off
